data.did_you_know: Look closely at the field across from the windmill: white linens are naturally bleached in the sun, a process that would have taken several months.
data.description: Even this early work by Jacob van Ruisdael—painted while he was still a teenager—shows his unique approach to landscape that made the simplest motifs seem grand and heroic. Dark forms are massed in the foreground, creating a stark contrast to the expansive, sunlit plain at left.
